openwrt_git.message:
ath79: Add support for OpenMesh MR1750 v2

Device specifications:
======================

* Qualcomm/Atheros QCA9558 ver 1 rev 0
* 720/600/240 MHz (CPU/DDR/AHB)
* 128 MB of RAM
* 16 MB of SPI NOR flash
  - 2x 7 MB available; but one of the 7 MB regions is the recovery image
* 3T3R 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (11n)
* 3T3R 5 GHz Wi-Fi (11ac)
* 6x GPIO-LEDs (2x wifi, 2x status, 1x lan, 1x power)
* 1x GPIO-button (reset)
* external h/w watchdog (enabled by default))
* TTL pins are on board (arrow points to VCC, then follows: GND, TX, RX)
* 1x ethernet
  - AR8035 ethernet PHY (RGMII)
  - 10/100/1000 Mbps Ethernet
  - 802.3af POE
  - used as LAN interface
* 12-24V 1A DC
* internal antennas

Flashing instructions:
======================

Various methods can be used to install the actual image on the flash.
Two easy ones are:

ap51-flash
----------

The tool ap51-flash (https://github.com/ap51-flash/ap51-flash) should be
used to transfer the image to the u-boot when the device boots up.

initramfs from TFTP
-------------------

The serial console must be used to access the u-boot shell during bootup.
It can then be used to first boot up the initramfs image from a TFTP server
(here with the IP 192.168.1.21):

   setenv serverip 192.168.1.21
   setenv ipaddr 192.168.1.1
   tftpboot 0c00000 <filename-of-initramfs-kernel>.bin && bootm $fileaddr

The actual sysupgrade image can then be transferred (on the LAN port) to the
device via

  scp <filename-of-squashfs-sysupgrade>.bin root@192.168.1.1:/tmp/

On the device, the sysupgrade must then be started using

  sysupgrade -n /tmp/<filename-of-squashfs-sysupgrade>.bin

Signed-off-by: Sven Eckelmann <sven@narfation.org>
[rebase, add LED migration]
Signed-off-by: Adrian Schmutzler <freifunk@adrianschmutzler.de>

openwrt_pr_3716.body_auszug: All these devices were part of the MR1750 image in the ar71xx target. These were now converted to ath79 and split into different images in this process. (Spezifikation v1 und v2 identisch: QCA9558, 720/600/240 MHz, 128 MB RAM, 16 MB SPI NOR, 3T3R 2.4 GHz 11n, 3T3R 5 GHz 11ac, 6 GPIO-LEDs, 1 Reset-Taster, externer HW-Watchdog, TTL-Pins auf der Platine, 1x GbE 802.3af PoE, 12-24V 1A DC, interne Antennen)

openwrt_dts.leds: lan_blue GPIO12, status_green GPIO19, status_red GPIO21, power_blue GPIO22 (default on), wifi5g blue GPIO23 (Trigger phy0tpt), WMAC-LED led-sources 13
openwrt_dts.watchdog: linux,wdt-gpio GPIO16, hw_algo toggle, hw_margin 300 s (Treiber auf 60 s begrenzt), always-running; SoC-wdt deaktiviert
openwrt_dts.flash: jedec,spi-nor 40 MHz; Partitionen u-boot 0x000000+0x40000 (ro), u-boot-env 0x40000+0x10000, custom 0x50000+0x60000 (ro), inactive 0xb0000+0x7a0000, inactive2 0x850000+0x7a0000, ART 0xff0000+0x10000 (ro)
openwrt_dts.ethernet: eth0 rgmii-id, PHY an MDIO-Adresse 5 (eee-broken-100tx, eee-broken-1000t), pll-data 0x82000000 0x80000101 0x80001313

openwrt_image_mk.Device/openmesh_mr1750-v2: $(Device/openmesh_common_64k); SOC := qca9558; DEVICE_MODEL := MR1750; DEVICE_VARIANT := v2; DEVICE_PACKAGES += kmod-ath10k-ct ath10k-firmware-qca988x-ct; OPENMESH_CE_TYPE := MR1750; SUPPORTED_DEVICES += mr1750v2
openwrt_image_mk.Device/openmesh_common_64k: DEVICE_VENDOR := OpenMesh; DEVICE_PACKAGES := uboot-envtools; IMAGE_SIZE := 7808k; sysupgrade.bin per openmesh-image ce_type

gluon_commit_bc71c91.titel: ath79-generic: Add support for OpenMesh MR1750 v2
gluon_commit_bc71c91.namenswechsel: The device had the image name "openmesh-mr1750v2" in older versions of Gluon. This had to be changed with the new name in the device trees of the ath79 device tree.

fcc_handbuch.Titel: Wireless-N / AC Long Range Ceiling Mount Dual Concurrent Access Point MR1750, V1.0 (First Release 2013/07/31)
fcc_handbuch.Features: Up to 300 Mbps for each band (2.4GHz / 5GHz); 10/100/1000 Gigabit Ethernet; IEEE 802.11 a/b/g/n; Multiple SSID (up to 8 per band); Power-over-Ethernet (IEEE802.3at/af); SNMP; QoS (WMM)

fcc_handbuch.Hardware Installation: Connect the Power Adapter DC connector to the DC-IN port ... POWER light (orange), 2.4GHz/5GHz WLAN light (green for 5G, blue for 2.4G), LAN light (blue)
fcc_handbuch.Mounting: ceiling or wall with mounting bracket (rotate clockwise about 90 degrees); T-rail connectors 15/16in (2.38cm) and 9/16in (1.43cm), spacers for drop ceiling; Kensington security slot
fcc_handbuch.Front Panel: Reset Button: One click for reset the device. Press over 10 seconds for reset to factory default. LED Lights for WPS, WLAN 5G, WLAN 2.4G, Ethernet port and Power.
fcc_handbuch.Rear Panel: Power: DC IN; Ethernet Port: RJ-45; Ceiling (Wall) Mount Hole; Kensington Security Slot

openmesh_datenblatt.Antenna: Six internal (2.4 GHz: 4 dBi; 5 GHz: 5 dBi)
openmesh_datenblatt.Processor: QCA9558 (Processor @ 700mhz MIPS74K + 2.4 GHz radio) + AR9880 (5 GHz Radio)
openmesh_datenblatt.Security: WPA/WPA2 Personal, WPA/WPA2 Enterprise, 802.1X RADIUS, captive portal, client isolation
openmesh_datenblatt.Mounting options: Solid ceiling, wall, 9/16” or 15/16” drop ceiling (included); outdoor enclosure ODMRX00 (optional)
openmesh_datenblatt.Fussnote PoE: * While most deployments will use less than 15.4W (802.3af), you may not be able to use high TX power with long cable runs and/or high client density unless your switch supports 802.3at, or up to 20w per port.
openmesh_datenblatt.Enclosure (MR Series Outdoor) Specificat: Size Diameter: 8.0cm (3.1") Depth: 4.5cm (1.8"); Compatible Power Supplies 802.3af PoE recommended; Material Bright white, UV-stabilized ABS plastic with rubber seal; Mounting Options Pole, wall; Warranty 1 Year
openmesh_datenblatt.Enclosure Text: The outdoor enclosure is ideal for covering an outdoor sector or for short range point to multi-point deployments with the narrower 180-degree antenna pattern of the MR Series access points.
openmesh_datenblatt.Features: Hardware Watchdog auto-restarts after power spikes and outages; dual band simultaneous 2.4GHz/5GHz, 3x3 configurations on wireless N or AC, Gigabit Ethernet, standard 802.3af PoE

openmesh_produktseite.Availability: In stock; The MR1750 will be discontinued soon.
openmesh_produktseite.Kurztext: High performance, 802.11ac cloud-managed access point with 802.3af/at Gigabit PoE. Lifetime cloud license included.
openmesh_produktseite.Details: cloud managed, dual band, 802.11ac mesh-capable access point that includes hardware watchdog, standard 802.3af/at POE support and a single Gigabit Ethernet port. 50-100 simultaneous users. 802.11ac replacement for the MR900.
openmesh_produktseite.Highlights: 3x3, 450+1300 Mbps MIMO; included wall/ceiling mount, optional outdoor enclosure
openmesh_produktseite.Power Supply/Adapter Option: Without Adapter | Universal 24v Power Supply for all OM and MR access points (+5)
openmesh_produktseite.Notes: We recommend powering this unit with standard 802.3af/at PoE. It is also compatible with the 24v universal power supply (add-on option). This access point is not compatible with Open Mesh passive PoE injectors. For optimal range, the MR1750 will mesh with other devices over the 2.4 GHz band only.
openmesh_produktseite.FCC-Hinweis: To comply with new FCC regulations, this device does not allow non-Open Mesh firmware to be loaded, and no SSH access within the US.
openmesh_produktseite.Compatible Enclosures: OM Indoor Ethernet, OM Indoor Ceiling, OM Indoor Wallplug, OM Outdoor, MR Outdoor
openmesh_produktseite.Downloads: Datasheet (MR-2016-06.pdf), Quick Start Guide (MR1750 Quick Start Guide v1_1.pdf), User Guide (MR1750v2 User Guide.pdf)
